name: Maja Olayinka
source:
Occupation: Court Magician
Height: 5'7
Alignment: Neutral Good
Star Sign: Capricorn
Characteristics: Poised, polite, intelligent, kind
Affiliation: The Crown

Maja hails from a highly respected noble family, but has no interest in using her familiy's name to get places. She's her own person, and she's determined to serve the crown with poise and grace. Painfully smart and kind, Maja educates the magically inclined citizens of Novus and assists with research and ensuring that the kingdom is safe, no matter what.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/errant-kingdom]Kickstarter[/url]]

Maja can be romanced on her own or as part of a polyamorous route with Erik.
